description: Update the internal type definitions for visitor compilation to properly distinguish between AST node visitors and CFG event handlers. Currently, the type system treats them identically, but they have different function signatures that need separate type definitions.
functional_requirements: Create distinct type definitions for AST node visitors and CFG event handlers
Ensure the visitor compilation logic correctly handles both types with their respective signatures
Update any type assertions or casts in the visitor compilation code to use the new type definitions
Maintain backward compatibility with existing plugin implementations
